# Surfing ESA

> Surfing ESA offers surf lessons in El Salvador, surfboard rentals in El Salvador and surf experiences in El Salvador, based in La Libertad and led by founder and head coach Josselyn "Joss" Alabi, an international SUP and surf athlete.

## What we do
Surfing ESA is a water sports company based in La Libertad, El Salvador, Central America. It teaches people of all ages and skill levels to surf and to stand up paddle, rents surfboards and SUP boards, and designs and operates water experience programs for hotels, resorts and companies. Every lesson includes gear, beach access and a professional instructor. Services are offered in English and Spanish.

## Services
- One-on-one lesson with transport: 1-hour private surf or SUP lesson anywhere in El Salvador, with round-trip transport and full gear. From $125.
- Surf lessons in El Salvador, one-on-one in La Libertad: 1-hour private lesson at the surf spot, beach access, instructor and full gear included. From $85.
- Group lessons: surf (1 to 3 people), SUP surf (1 to 2 people) and SUP (1 to 4 people). Group rate on request.
- Special monthly rate: recurring lessons all month with preferred pricing.
- Surfboard rentals in El Salvador: soft top boards for beginners and high-performance boards for progressing surfers.
- Surf experiences in El Salvador: guided surf and SUP surf sessions for travelers, groups, hotels and companies.
- SUP rentals: board and paddle, or paddle only.
- Hotel and resort water experience management: outsourced guest water programs (instructors, equipment, operations).
- Corporate events, team building and activations: surf competitions, sponsorships and ocean-side brand activations.
- Coming soon: sailing and rowing in partnership with national federations (waitlist open).
- Special prices for Salvadorans.

## Problems we solve
- "I want to learn to surf in El Salvador but do not know where to go." Surfing ESA chooses the right spot for your level and the conditions of the day, then shares all the details.
- "I do not have a board or gear." Lessons include full gear, and boards can be rented.
- "I need transport from my hotel or city." The one-on-one lesson with transport picks you up anywhere in El Salvador.
- "Our hotel or company needs a safe, professional water program." Surfing ESA designs, operates and advises on programs built on elite safety standards.

## Who it is for
Travelers and residents in El Salvador of any age and level who want to surf or SUP, from first-timers to progressing surfers; hotels, resorts and companies that want water experiences for guests or teams.

## Proof
- Founder Josselyn Alabi: 10+ years competing, 7 SUP World Championships, 2 Olympic cycles, 34+ medals and trophies, national team member in rowing, SUP surfing and sailing.
- Gold medal at the Bolivarian Games; ambassador of Marca País El Salvador for Salvadoran sports; sports success recognition from the Presidency of El Salvador.
- Every lesson booked helps fund Mar de Sueños, a social foundation for coastal youth, and connects to Waves Well SUP retreats.
